near_workers_note: NEAR Agent Market workers run locally on this VM (verdict-row :8080, route-auditor :8081, repo-vitals :8082). Unlike the stall sections above — which render the standing checker's recorded state — this section is a live point-in-time probe taken at generated_at; each worker carries its own checked_at. ok=false with a probe error means the worker did not answer at build time (couldn't retrieve), not that it was omitted.
refresh: This page is a static snapshot regenerated by fleet_status.py when it runs alongside standing-checker runs (manual cadence — not a live monitor). The generated_at and checker last-run timestamps above are the freshness record: if they are old, the numbers are old, and they say so.
title: Verdict Row — Fleet Status

window.basis: The standing checker (check.py) retains only its latest run — state.json is overwritten on every run and no multi-run checker history exists — so ok_share is computed over the 1 run actually recorded: 1.0 when the route was ok on that run, 0.0 when it was failing. It is a last-check share, not a long-window uptime SLO.
